gloss: to climb to the top, to rise to the highest position

definitions.gloss: to climb to the very top
definitions.explanation: To ascend all the way to the summit or peak of a physical location.

definitions.gloss: to rise to the highest position, to reach the pinnacle
definitions.explanation: To advance through ranks or stages to reach the very top of a career, organization, or field. The figurative sense is more common.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{頂上|ちょうじょう}まで{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}めた。
examples.english: I climbed all the way to the top of the mountain.

examples.japanese: {階段|かいだん}を{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}めると{展望台|てんぼうだい}に{出|で}た。
examples.english: After climbing all the way up the stairs, I came out at the observation deck.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{坂|さか}を{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}めた{先|さき}に{神社|じんじゃ}があった。
examples.english: At the top of the long slope I had climbed, there was a shrine.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}の{座|ざ}に{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}めた。
examples.english: He rose to the position of company president.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{実力|じつりょく}で{業界|ぎょうかい}のトップに{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}めた。
examples.english: She rose to the top of the industry through sheer ability.

examples.japanese: {下積|したづ}みの{時代|じだい}を{経|へ}て、ようやく{頂点|ちょうてん}に{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}めた{選手|せんしゅ}の{姿|すがた}に{感動|かんどう}した。
examples.english: I was moved by the athlete who finally reached the pinnacle after years of working from the bottom.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound verb combining {登|のぼ}る (to climb) with {詰|つ}める (to pack in, to push to the limit). The {詰|つ}める component adds the nuance of going all the way, leaving nothing further to ascend. The figurative sense (career advancement) is more frequent than the literal one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- トップに{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}める: to rise to the top
- {頂点|ちょうてん}に{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}める: to reach the pinnacle
- {権力|けんりょく}の{座|ざ}に{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}める: to rise to a seat of power
- {社長|しゃちょう}に{登|のぼ}り{詰|つ}める: to rise to become president
